# Insydz

> Insydz is India's AI-powered ecommerce analytics software built for Amazon India and Flipkart sellers. It helps sellers understand their data, track competitors, monitor reviews, and make faster, more profitable selling decisions — without guessing.

Insydz is headquartered in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. The platform is trusted by 5,000+ sellers and has analysed 2.5 lakh+ reviews. It provides 24/7 live market data and is designed specifically for Indian marketplace dynamics, including ₹-denominated pricing intelligence.

---

## What Insydz Does

Insydz is a marketplace analytics platform that consolidates Amazon India and Flipkart data into a single dashboard. It gives sellers:

- Real-time revenue, order, and return tracking
- AI-powered product and keyword insights
- Competitor price tracking and Buy Box intelligence
- Review analysis and sentiment monitoring
- Profit margin visibility by SKU
- Festive season trend forecasting (e.g., Big Billion Days prep)
- AI chat for querying your own seller data

The platform is built for Indian marketplaces specifically — not a re-skinned version of US-centric tools like Helium 10 or Jungle Scout.

## Key Features

- **Unified Dashboard**: Amazon India + Flipkart data in one view
- **AI Chat**: Ask questions about your own seller data in natural language
- **Competitor Tracking**: Monitor competitor pricing, listings, and Buy Box wins
- **Review Intelligence**: Analyse and monitor customer reviews at scale
- **AI Chart Summaries**: Auto-generated insights on your performance charts
- **Real-Time Alerts**: Instant notifications when competitors move on your products
- **Festive Trend Feature**: Strategic data for high-stakes sale seasons
- **Multi-Client Management**: Agency workflows with one-click report generation
- **Enterprise Security**: Bank-grade encryption; seller data stays private

Features page: https://insydz.com/features
Festive Trend Feature: https://insydz.com/features/festive-trend-feature

## Pricing

All plans are billed monthly with no credit card required to start. Cancel anytime.

### Free — ₹0/month
- Basic dashboard access
- Up to 25 products tracked
- Top 5 products filter
- 5 notifications
- Weekly reports

### Basic — ₹1,999/month (was ₹3,999)
- Up to 500 products tracked
- Top 20 products filter
- 20 AI chat messages/month
- 15 notifications
- AI Chart Summaries
- Basic competitor alerts
- Daily reports
- Email support

### Premium — ₹2,999/month (was ₹7,999)
- Unlimited product tracking
- Top 100 products filter
- Unlimited AI chat
- Unlimited notifications
- Advanced AI chatbot
- Real-time data and alerts
- Priority support
- Advanced analytics

### Enterprise — Custom Pricing
- All Premium features
- White-label options
- 24/7 premium support
- Contact: https://insydz.com/about/contact-us

Pricing page: https://insydz.com/pricing

## Competitive Positioning

Insydz positions itself as the India-first alternative to global tools that weren't built for Indian marketplace nuances.

- **vs Helium 10**: Indian marketplace coverage Helium 10 can't match; premium features at a fraction of the cost; ₹-denominated pricing intelligence.
  Compare: https://insydz.com/compare/insydzvshelium

- **vs Jungle Scout**: Amazon India + Flipkart in one dashboard; AI insights that understand Indian buyer behaviour.
  Compare: https://insydz.com/compare/insydzvsjunglescout

- **vs Viral Launch**: Agency-optimised workflows for Indian businesses; localised market intelligence.
  Compare: https://insydz.com/compare/insydzvsvirallaunch
